text: The property located at 325 N MAIN ST, MANVILLE, NJ, 08835 is currently in FEMA zone X, which is an area of minimal flood hazard outside the 1 percent annual-chance floodplain. Over the 30 year period from 2026 to 2055, the local 100-year rainfall amount is projected to increase by 48 percent from 8.21 inches to 12.2 inches in Somerset County. Board members should consider asking whether the stormwater system is sized using these future rainfall projections and how the site handles extreme rainfall events like Tropical Storm Ida in 2021.
